picks.title: iPadOS Gets Native Zelda: Ocarina of Time Port Via AI
picks.headline: iPadOS Gets Native Zelda: Ocarina of Time Port Via AI
picks.excerpt: AI-assisted decompilation/recompilation has produced a native iPadOS port of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, freeing the classic from N64 frame-rate caps and low-resolution constraints. A concrete example of generative/AI tooling reshaping game porting and preservation workflows — turning a months-long reverse-engineering effort into a far faster pipeline.
picks.rationale: Fresh (2026-07-28), concrete AI-decompilation workflow that speeds classic-game porting and preservation; distinct from the published Mario Kart Wii recompile card (different game, platform, and project).
